limits: Native MathML structure verified. No screenshot or browser layout validation performed in this read-only audit.

bookWorkedStepReview.method: All 50 complete source solution strings previously reviewed for signs, exponent precedence, factorization identities, real versus complex roots, distinct roots, aggregates and ordered comparisons. Latest strings each match that independently derived source review.

allEquationDuplicateAudit.method: Expand both sides with an independent polynomial parser, including TeX fractions; move RHS to LHS; divide by leading coefficient. Therefore equations that differ only by a nonzero scalar count as duplicates. Includes all 50 book plus 60 generated fixtures.

transferEquationNovelty.scope: Confirms equation novelty relative to the 50 supplied book fixtures. This checks numerical transfer within existing template families; it does not establish mastery of untested methods or whether a learner has already seen a generated question.
